objective: Measure whether changes in market state explain relative strategy performance before declaring focused switching hypotheses.
strategy_policy: Evaluate every non-benchmark strategy present in each comparable evidence cohort.
selection_policy: Unfocused retrospective scan with family-wide multiplicity correction; any promising relationship must be placed in a later frozen focused generation before untouched-forward evaluation.
benchmark_policy: Compare against SPY and require any eventual router to also beat the best eligible fixed strategy, including STATIC_MULTI_SLEEVE.
